posts.cooked:
With the last stream of OblivAeon on an iPhone, the bits I saw mostly ran well but crashed completely a couple of times. There’s also a couple of characters (Sky-scraper and the Sentinels) who are known to completely break things, so they’ll want that fixed before release. So it’s in the final stages, but since it’s so complex there’s a lot of opportunity for bugs to appear, which could delay it for who-knows-how-long.

But I hear the listening party is coming up, and that’s very encouraging!
